mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact permits two AuditEntry atoms with identical (task, actor, role, op) — a 'replacement' pattern that violates immutability. The injection forces exactly such a pair to exist, so AppendOnly and FR_017_AuditImmutableOutlivesTask both find counterexamples.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.entryTask = ae2.entryTask and ae1.entryActor = ae2.entryActor and ae1.entryActorRole = ae2.entryActorRole and ae1.entryOp = ae2.entryOp }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the permission matrix fact removes all constraints on PermMatrix.Allowed, so the solver can place RelOutsider -> GetTaskById in the allowed set, violating LeastPrivilege and NoInformationLeakage. The injection forces that exact cell to be present.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermMatrixViolation { RelOutsider -> GetTaskById in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a user from a different team to appear in taskSharees, violating the cross-team-sharing prohibition. The injection forces a Task whose sharedWith includes a user from a different team.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamShareViolation { some t: Task, s: t.taskSharees | s.userTeam != t.taskTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a Task to exist without any OpCreated audit entry, breaking AuditCompleteness and ValidationBeforeMutation. The injection forces a Task with no Created entry.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingCreatedAudit { some t: Task | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.entryTask = t and ae.entryOp = OpCreated }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets the stored actorRole in an AuditEntry differ from the actor's actual role, producing a misattributed audit record. The injection forces an entry where entryActorRole = RoleMember but the actor's userRole = RoleTeamAdmin.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MisattributedRole { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.entryActorRole = RoleMember and ae.entryActor.userRole = RoleTeamAdmin }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a Task whose owner is in a different team than the task's team_id, breaking the denormalization invariant that underpins cross-team isolation queries. The injection forces exactly that mismatch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnerTeamMismatch { some t: Task | t.taskOwner.userTeam != t.taskTeam }
